name: product-feedback-app
description: A challenge on Frontend Mentor to build a product feedback app

paragraphs: A fully interactive product feedback board that lets users browse suggestions, filter and sort requests, upvote ideas, leave nested comments, and track delivery progress on a visual roadmap. Built as a solution to the Frontend Mentor Product Feedback App challenge.

This single-page application replicates a product-management feedback workflow. Seed data is loaded from a JSON mock API, then all subsequent reads and writes — votes, comments, replies, and CRUD operations — persist in the browser via localStorage, so the board stays in sync after a refresh.
Replace the image above with a current screenshot of the home, roadmap, or details view.
features: 🧭 Suggestions board — Browse product requests with title, description, category tag, upvote count, and comment count on a dedicated home view.
🏷️ Category filtering — Filter suggestions from the sidebar by All or by a live category list derived from the data (feature, enhancement, bug, and any custom tags).
↕️ Sorting — Sort the board by Most upvotes, Least upvotes, Most comments, or Least comments from the top-bar dropdown (defaults to most upvotes).
➕ Create feedback — Add a new request with title, category (custom dropdown), and detail fields. New items are stored as suggestion with zero upvotes.
✏️ Edit feedback — Update title, category, and description while preserving status, upvotes, and existing comments.
